scope: Declared continuous piecewise-linear 3D centerline and noisy image-feature simulator; no B-mode, clinical, learned acoustic, or patient population calibration claim.

coordinates.pose: [x_m,y_m,yaw_rad] in public body-local skin plane z=0
coordinates.probe: Rz(yaw); image plane probe Y=0; u=probe X; depth=-probe Z
coordinates.body_to_world: external public rigid map; no patient geometry in mapping

prior.curve: persistent continuous 101-knot polyline generated by natural cubic interpolation of five correlated residual controls
prior.decoy: second persistent curve drawn from same legal lane/slope/depth geometry family; identity measurements overlap; either can show a long centered image segment

visibility.algorithm: Liang-Barsky exact interval clipping of every continuous segment to all six slab/FOV/depth planes; sum arclength only within connected components; choose longest connected component per source; public segment geometry is projected from clipped points only
visibility.detector: competing target and decoy returns, each probability based only on its clipped support and persistent detectability; no action-table sensor
visibility.miss: u/depth/axis/length/identity are None; no fallback target coordinates

observation.axis_definition: unsigned 2D principal image axis in (u,depth), never a hidden 3D vessel tangent
observation.identifiability: A single 2D image does not identify out-of-plane yaw. Public LA proxy uses projected connected length >=15mm, |u|<=2mm, identity>=0.75, contact; 10deg 3D axis-plane criterion belongs to independent audit. Causal reconstructed-line estimates may guide servo but are never relabeled truth.

audit.requirements: true selected source is target, true contact, true connected physical length>=15mm, true |image centroid u|<=2mm, true RMS tangent out-of-plane angle<=10deg
audit.use: renderer/audit only; never policy, likelihood, training label, candidate generation, or belief update

belief.legal_particles: independently sampled from prior, no truth injection; persistent curves and nuisance identity/detectability
belief.update: unique frame IDs only; actual source mixture likelihood against all particles; stable log weights; no robot/dIRD rewards
belief.rejuvenation: resample when ESS low followed by MH moves targeting full accumulated public observation likelihood times original prior; report raw ESS, max weight, degeneracy events, resampling and acceptance; no silent ESS=1

servo: common public-history-only continuous correction of u along probe X; public visible-length finite-difference yaw/normal search; causal reconstructed-line proposal only if span and line-fit quality valid; legal template/belief poses for misses; x,y,yaw continuous targets, no 10mm action ceiling
motion: external native C2 adapter owned by root; no Module C use here
training: analytic exact geometric response is baseline substrate; no learned residual claimed unless separate public visible-source-pair training demonstrates benefit
heldout_rule: do not instantiate or inspect split test until root review and explicit release
